newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Kabila's minister in Zimbabwe for OAU meeting.
newsitem.headline: Kabila's minister in Zimbabwe for OAU meeting.

text.p: Democratic Republic of Congo Foreign Minister Bizima Karaha arrived in Zimbabwe late on Friday for an Organisation of African Unity (OAU) meeting, the first for Laurent Kabila's government since it took power in the former Zaire.

OAU officials said Karaha was likely to address fellow foreign ministers on Saturday night when they reconvene to adopt an agenda for a summit of the 53-member organisation due to be held in Harare next week.
The OAU foreign ministers met for two days from Thursday to prepare for the June 2-4 summit. On Saturday they toured local tourist resorts.

The OAU summit is expected to be attended by some 30 heads of state and government, including Kabila whose rebel forces forced former long-serving Zairean president Mobutu Sese Seko to flee earlier this month.
The conference is due to discuss among other issues, the Great Lakes Region, the coup in Sierra Leone and developments in Somalia and Angola.
